messages:
maria: Heads up — saw duplicate objects created when our async Python client retried after a 502. Looks like the request body wasn't replayable so the server created twice.
kevin: ugh. do you have a minimal repro or logs? is this the streaming path or plain json post?
maria: plain json. async client with aiohttp transport. repro snippet below (simplified):
```py
async with AsyncClient(api_key=...) as c:
    await c.post('/v1/resources', json={'name': 'test'}, timeout=10)
```
On 1st attempt we get 502, client retries, but server ends up creating two resources.
olga: are you setting an idempotency key? if not server-side should probably reject duplicate creates.
maria: We tried sending `Idempotency-Key` header manually and it helps — but it's brittle because some helper paths stream the body (files/chunks) and then the body is consumed so subsequent retries can't re-send. The SDK currently doesn't automatically attach idempotency keys.
kevin: hmm. two related gaps: (1) SDK should document replayability guarantees for each transport + API surface; (2) consider automatic idempotency-key injection for non-streaming requests.
sam: also we should unify default retry/backoff behavior: decorrelated jitter + classify 5xx/502/503 as retryable. Right now transports differ in backoff defaults which causes inconsistent replay windows.
olga: proposal: add Request.replayable boolean and let transports opt into buffering small JSON bodies for replay. For streaming uploads, require caller to provide Idempotency-Key or use resumable uploads pattern.
kevin: +1. And we need types: AsyncClient.post(...) should clarify in typing whether body can be replayed or needs bytes buffer. Maybe add overloads in stub types.
maria: for immediate fix, can we have the client auto-add Idempotency-Key when no streaming body is detected? fallback to not retrying on non-idempotency by default.
kevin: implementation notes: 1) add detect_streaming_body() util; 2) if not streaming, auto-inject RFC4122 UUID header unless user provided one; 3) make it controllable via client config `auto_idempotency: Optional[bool]` (default True).
sam: plus expose a retry hook/callback so apps can decide to suppress retries for specific endpoints. e.g., `client.on_retry = lambda req, resp: ...`
olga: i'll draft a design doc and type PR. will also add a small test matrix for aiohttp vs httpx transports to ensure parity.
kevin: awesome. can we also add telemetry event when we auto-inject idempotency so customers can see when the SDK prevented duplicates?
maria: yes please. that will help debugging. thanks y'all. :pray:
devex-bot: Created issue -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/482 (auto idempotency + replayable request flag) :rocket:
